'''Oligtaz''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Riders" /> located in the [[Oligtaz system/Legends|Oligtaz system]], in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was the site of the [[Esraza Temple]], which was known to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[10,000 BBY]]. Early explorers described the structure as a reality-warping nexus that granted visitors the abilities of teleportation and farseeing.<ref name="TEA" /> By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of the [[Esraza Temple]], ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the temple lay in ruins, and researchers hypothesized that the structure had been situated above a [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] of [[lumni-spice]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oligtaz was first mentioned in [[Ray Winninger]]'s [[1989]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']].<ref name="Riders" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-12.<ref name="TEA" />
